name: manager
description: Customer-facing agent for Example National Bank. Answers general questions about the bank, such as hours, contact details and products, and routes account questions to the deposit and loan agents over A2A.

skills.name: General banking information
skills.description: Answers questions about branch hours, contact details, products offered and deposit insurance, without reaching any customer data.
examples: What kinds of accounts do you offer?
How do I report a lost card?

skills.name: Deposit account questions
skills.description: Routes questions about deposit accounts, balances and transactions to the deposit agent over A2A and relays the answer.
examples: What is my current balance on the vacation account?
What was my most recent payment?

skills.name: Loan questions and applications
skills.description: Routes questions about loans, repayments and new borrowing to the loan agent over A2A and relays the answer.
examples: When is my next auto payment due?
Can I borrow $10,000 for a car?
